item.title: Strait of Hormuz closed, 3000 vessels, 20,000 seafarers stranded in Middle East – IMO
item.description: The IMO disclosed that the Strait of Hormuz was closed after a tugboat assisting another vessel in the strait on Friday morning was struck killing four seafarers. item.title: 30 banks meet requirements as recapitalisation exercise progresses – CBN
item.description: "As of 6 March, the recapitalisation exercise is progressing steadily. 30 banks have met the new minimum capital requirements applicable to their respective licence authorisations." item.title: NERD certificate now prerequisite for NYSC – Minister
item.description: The Nigerian government had directed all Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs) of government to comply with the NERD policy introduced in August. The post NERD certificate now prerequisite for NYSC – Minister appeared first on Premium Times Nigeria.

item.title: FEC proposes bill to enable National Medical College issue PhDs, says fellowship not equivalent to PhD
item.description: The minister has also clarified that the proposal was not to make medical fellowships equivalent of PhDs. The post FEC proposes bill to enable National Medical College issue PhDs, says fellowship not equivalent to PhD appeared first on Premium Times Nigeria.

item.title: Advocacy group calls for urgent action on women’s economic participation in Nigeria
item.description: The report highlights wide disparities in gender equality protections across Nigerian states, creating an uneven playing field for women depending on where they live and work. item.title: WHO backs rollout of new HIV prevention drug in nine countries
item.description: Mr Ghebreyesus said a new medicine approved in 2025 for HIV prevention, Lenacapavir, represents the most significant development in combating HIV since the first antiretroviral treatments were approved nearly 40 years ago.
